message: My daughter is an inmate and their facility said I should buy prepaid calling time with T-Netix. After stumbling on your site and reading all about problems others have had with this company, I wonder if there is another company that can be used besides this one. The calls are tremendously expensive but I feel that we need to talk to her once a week to keep her on a positive note so we can have positive results when she gets out. Is there another answer?
